notes: The command as shipped cannot complete: (a) the test domain 1.0 is never generated by data_gen_syn.py (spur_corr_list= [0.0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.90], data_gen_syn.py:42), so loading '..._spur_corr_1.0_case_test_seed_0.pickle' raises FileNotFoundError at train.py:221 before training starts; (b) utils/slab_data.py:75 hard-codes base_dir= '/home/t-dimaha/RobustDG/robustdg/data/datasets/slab/' while data_gen_syn.py:35 writes to the relative 'data/datasets/slab/'. Neither is a flag; both need code edits (e.g. add 1.0 to spur_corr_list and fix the path) for the command to run.

Domain semantics: the domain value is corrupt_lin = fraction of samples whose linear (spurious, coordinate 0) feature is replaced by Uniform[-0.1, 0.1] (corrupt_lin_margin=True, utils/scripts/gendata.py:105-108); uncorrupted samples have X0 = (2Y-1)*(0.1+0.9U) (gendata.py:102). So train domains 0.0/0.1 have a 100%/90% predictive linear feature; test domain 1.0 would have an uninformative linear feature. The slab feature (coordinate 1, 7 slabs) has 10% label noise (slab_noise 0.1 -> corrupt_slab7, gendata.py:221-249).

Model selection and reported number: per run, the test accuracy at np.argmax(val_acc) over the 100 epochs (val = 250+250 samples from the train domains' val split); mean and population SD over 10 runs printed as 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)'. The 'Target Validation' line (oracle: max test acc over epochs) is also printed. Logs go to results/slab/logs/<method>.txt.

Hyperparameters in reproduce_slab.py correspond to the grids in reproduce_scripts/slab-tune.py (penalty in [0.1,1,10] for rand/perf/mmd/coral variants, [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] for dann variants; grad_penalty in [0.01,0.1,1,10]; d_steps in [1,2,4,8]; 3 seeds). slab-tune.py selects the best config by data[-4] of the log (slab-tune.py:83,95), which is the 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)' line, i.e. the TEST-domain (1.0) accuracy at the source-val-selected epoch, despite the comment '# Source validation accuracy'. So the provided tuning procedure picks hyperparameters using target-domain test accuracy.

DANN specifics: DANN ignores --lr and the base SGD(momentum 0.9, nesterov) optimizer; it uses two plain SGD optimizers with hard-coded lr 0.01, wd 5e-4, no momentum (algorithms/dann.py:38-51). Discriminator/generator alternation is decided per EPOCH, not per step: 'if (epoch % (1+d_steps_per_g) < d_steps_per_g)' (dann.py:108), so dann (d_steps 4) trains the classifier/featurizer only in epochs 4,9,...,99 and c-dann (d_steps 2) only in epochs 2,5,...,98. The gradient penalty uses disc_softmax[:, disc_labels].sum() (dann.py:91), and the generator loss subtracts lambda*(disc CE + grad_penalty*gp).

ERM/Rand/Perf (method erm_match) do not train on the shuffled train loader batches: they iterate it only for step count and train on matched tuples built once at epoch 0 (match_flag 0, erm_match.py:33-38) from utils/match_function.py:get_matched_pairs. For each class the domain with more samples is the base; every base point is paired with one point of the other domain (random same-class point for match_case 0.0; a random same-class point from the same slab id, re-drawn each batch, for match_case 1.0). The epoch loop breaks after len(data_matched) chunks of 128 (erm_match.py:62-64), i.e. about 8 steps per epoch, each with ~256 samples. For erm the matching weight is 0, so its CE is over base-domain points plus resampled points of the other domain.

MMD/CORAL variants and DANN variants train on standard shuffled mixed-domain batches of 128 (utils/helper.py:298) and apply the penalty on the 100-d ReLU feature (phi.feat_net), not on logits. For 2 train domains, the pair normalisation nmb*(nmb-1)/2 equals 1.
Weight decay in training is 5e-4 (train.py:63 default); the 'weight_decay': 5e-5 and 'lr': 0.1 entries in data_gen_syn.py's config (lines 86-87) are unused by training.

Checkpoint file names (algorithms/algo.py:98 post_string) do not include --gaussian/--conditional/--grad_penalty/--d_steps_per_g_step, and base_res_dir uses method_name (train.py:193-200). So mmd, c-mmd, coral and c-coral (all method_name 'mmd', penalty_ws 0.1) overwrite each other's saved models, as do dann and c-dann. This does not affect the numbers printed by the 'train' case (computed in-process), only the 'evaluate' case of reproduce_slab.py.

reproduce_slab.py 'evaluate' runs test.py with --test_metric per_domain_acc --acc_data_case train (per-domain accuracy on training data) and aggregates as mean and np.std/sqrt(n) (standard error, test.py:399); this is not the Table 1 path in the notebook.

Runtime requirements visible in code: a CUDA device is assumed (train.py:169 cuda= torch.device('cuda:' ...), model moved with .to(cuda)); algorithms/algo.py:240 imports opacus inside get_test_accuracy and calls opacus.autograd_grad_sample.enable_hooks() every evaluation (opacus is in requirements_new.txt as opacus==0.13.0 but not in requirements.txt); algorithms/algo.py:8 needs more_itertools.

Seeding: training seeds are run*10 for python random, numpy and torch (train.py:209-213); the data file used is seed index = run (0..9), generated by data_gen_syn.py with np.random.seed(seed*10) once per seed, then drawn sequentially for all (slab_noise, spur_corr, case) combinations. No cudnn determinism flags are set in train.py.
